armContract.A: Run the exact existing non-plugin workflow named by each skill contract, with the rhize-devflow skill disabled.
armContract.B: Run the same task through the named rhize-devflow plugin skill path.
armContract.actualExecutionRule: A record identifies the arm and variant that actually ran; requested, assigned, or intended arms are not execution evidence.

evidenceRules.comparisonGate: Only same-task, same-snapshot, judge-compatible paired records are comparable.

armA.implementation: Use the active browser capability documentation and server help without loading rhize-devflow:chrome-devtools-mcp.

armB.implementation: Load rhize-devflow:chrome-devtools-mcp and follow its DevTools-protocol mechanics path.

skills.judge: Correct connection/tool parameters with no accidental routing of general browser acceptance work.

armA.implementation: Apply the repository's existing push policy and protected-branch PR mechanics without loading rhize-devflow:completed-branch-promotion.

armB.implementation: Load rhize-devflow:completed-branch-promotion and apply its governed promotion sequence to the same fixture repository.

skills.judge: Correct authorization, dirty-worktree preservation, divergence stops, gate handling, and truthful release result; no real remote mutation.

armA.implementation: Run the existing deterministic mutation-analysis scripts and inspect their report without loading rhize-devflow:data-mutation-consistency.

armB.implementation: Load rhize-devflow:data-mutation-consistency and use its read-only mutation-check workflow over the same fixture.

skills.judge: Finds the seeded cross-layer invalidation defect without editing source or producing a partial score on scan failure.

armA.implementation: Use repository instructions, existing CodeGraph when present, and targeted native search without loading rhize-devflow:dev-flow-foundations.

armB.implementation: Load rhize-devflow:dev-flow-foundations and follow its structural discovery and semantic impact-map sequence.

skills.judge: Complete affected-symbol/test/contract map with no unrelated scope expansion or invented dependency edges.

armA.implementation: Inspect the same redacted deployment logs, Sentry event facts, and Git history using the existing incident workflow without loading rhize-devflow:error-lifecycle-management.

armB.implementation: Load rhize-devflow:error-lifecycle-management and follow its triage, correlation, root-cause, and verification sequence over the same evidence.

skills.judge: Identifies the seeded root cause and verification gate without guessing beyond the evidence or mutating production.

armA.implementation: Use the repository's existing Sanity patterns and official Sanity reference without loading rhize-devflow:sanity-development.

armB.implementation: Load rhize-devflow:sanity-development and apply its Rhize schema, query, and integration conventions.

skills.judge: Correct schema/query review, named-export and query-naming compliance, and no unsafe deletion of populated fields.

armA.implementation: Use the installed official Sentry SDK guidance and repository conventions without loading rhize-devflow:sentry-instrumentation.

armB.implementation: Load rhize-devflow:sentry-instrumentation and apply its Rhize exception, span, and structured-logging patterns.

skills.judge: Correct capture/span/logging placement with sensitive-data controls and no confusion with incident triage.

armA.implementation: Simplify the same scoped diff using repository conventions and tests without loading rhize-devflow:simplify.

armB.implementation: Load rhize-devflow:simplify and apply its candidate gate to the same scoped diff.

skills.judge: Behavior and critical contracts preserved, complexity reduced only when proven, and a justified no-op accepted.

armA.implementation: Run the repository's existing trusted test command and inspect the test diff without loading rhize-devflow:test-evidence.

armB.implementation: Load rhize-devflow:test-evidence and produce its fail-closed, state-bound classification for the same test change.

skills.judge: Correct behavior/artifact/structural classification, state binding, unavailable status, and checkout preservation.
